basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and technology enthusiast based in Austin, Texas. I work as a software engineer for a major tech company, spending my free time exploring new game compositions and tinkering with vintage cars. I've been married for 10 years and enjoy quiet weekends with my family and our two rescue dogs. My online hours are typically in the evenings and on weekends, where I engage with various communities about gaming tips and automotive restoration.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science from the University of Texas, I've built a career around software development and tech innovation. My passion for gaming and music composition is self-taught, stemming from a childhood fascination with video game soundtracks. I frequently contribute to discussions on game music theory and automotive electronics, drawing from both professional experience and personal interest.
